act.py.modifications: Modified by HumanoidToolBench: optional language conditioning (ACTConfig.language_dim; a zero-initialized projection of the text embedding is added to the robot-state token, using zero_projection from humanoidtoolbench.policies._language), per-sample losses in eval mode, and loss values returned as detached tensors instead of Python floats.

diffusion_policy.py.modifications: Modified by HumanoidToolBench: optional language conditioning (language_dim; a zero-initialized projection of the text embedding is added to the image features, using zero_projection from humanoidtoolbench.policies._language), per-sample losses in eval mode, and denoising timesteps moved to the model device once per call while the scheduler stays on the CPU.
